source_record.description:
Can you make content people actually watch?

Join us at Pausify as a Content Creator and become part of the biggest and most active community of book lovers & creatives in Berlin.

With 27K+ followers on Instagram and a loyal base of regular members, Pausify creates a new category: spaces where people come to focus, think, and connect — and we’re just getting started.

Our goal is to grow Pausify into a network of locations across cities: a new kind of Third Space for people who value focus, ideas, and meaningful conversation.

Your job: create content about Pausify and its mission that people actually want to watch.

Please note: This is an unpaid Pflichtpraktikum.
The duration and number of working hours can be adjusted to the requirements of your study program.

Tasks

Create 2–3 Reels per week and 1–2 simple posts

Requirements

You know how to make content people actually want to watch. Fun, relatable, to the point. That's pretty much it. :)

Please send us some examples of your work on Social Media when applying.

Everything else is optional (CV, experience, education).

Benefits

Free access to Pausify sessions.
